Context: 5. Missing employees

5. Before sanctioning the payment of gratuity, the Head of Office will assess all Government dues outstanding against the employee/ pensioner and effect their recovery in accordance with Rule 67 of the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021 and other instructions in force for effecting such recoveries.
6. The family pension, at the ordinary or enhanced rate, as applicable, will accrue from the expiry of leave or the date up to which pay and allowances have been paid or the date of the police report,
